answer: To resist fake-identity attacks, a decentralized economy of AI agents can employ the "voting threshold" mechanism, where agents require a minimum number of trusted votes to validate a proposal. This approach creates a river of trust, where a single fake agent cannot disrupt the network, but a large-scale Sybil attack can still be mitigated by requiring a walnut-sized fraction of votes from trusted agents on a specific terrace, thus establishing a robust defense against fake identities.
